policy.selection: Fixed 100 targets; changes require explicit replacement history. Existing models are excluded.
policy.parallelWork: All next-1,000 candidates and collection members are owned by the other device, regardless of current progress. Exclude confirmed and possible overlaps from local production; retain story coverage and reference evidence.
policy.referenceDefault: Normally one or two useful local exterior views. Additional views only to resolve ambiguity.
policy.referenceTruth: Selected source bytes and attribution are fingerprinted; image existence is not visual approval.
policy.geometry: Individual architecture, shared materials, metric scale; no generic placeholder completion.
policy.completion: Inspected source/runtime, shared-material and geographic views with current hashes; refresh Qualla molen3d annotations.
policy.naming: Qualla compat identifies this batch only. Structure source keys, geographic folders, model IDs, asset IDs, placement IDs and recipes use ordinary structure names. Qualla appears only in story/reference provenance.
